mapper.sql: b.id, b.batch_name, b.grade, b.academic_year, b.instrument_id, b.open_at, b.close_at, b.interview_required, b.interview_note, b.notice_title, b.notice_url, b.status, b.published_at, b.closed_at, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.deleted, COALESCE(i.name, '') AS instrument_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.nickname, c.username) AS created_by_name
FROM psyche_batch b LEFT JOIN psyche_instrument i ON i.id = b.instrument_id LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = b.created_by

sql.if: AND (b.batch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.grade LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.academic_year LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_batch (batch_name, grade, academic_year, instrument_id, open_at, close_at, interview_required, interview_note, notice_title, notice_url, status, published_at, closed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchName}, #{grade}, #{academicYear}, #{instrumentId}, #{openAt}, #{closeAt}, #{interviewRequired}, #{interviewNote}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeUrl}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:

ORDER BY b.grade DESC, b.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE psyche_batch SET batch_name = #{batch.batchName}, grade = #{batch.grade}, academic_year = #{batch.academicYear}, instrument_id = #{batch.instrumentId}, open_at = #{batch.openAt}, close_at = #{batch.closeAt}, interview_required = #{batch.interviewRequired}, interview_note = #{batch.interviewNote}, notice_title = #{batch.noticeTitle}, notice_url = #{batch.noticeUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{batch.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
